group.passage:
To most people, the shipping container is just a large metal box on the back of a truck, yet few inventions have done more to shape the modern world. Before the 1950s, dock workers loaded ships by hand, carrying sacks, barrels, and crates on board one at a time, so a ship could spend nearly as long in port as it did at sea.
An American trucking businessman named Malcom McLean believed there had to be a better way. His answer was a steel box that could move from truck to ship to train without ever being opened. There was one [[1]]: the system would only work if ports, ships, and railways around the world all used boxes of the same size. Dock workers, fearing for their jobs, fought the change at first, but the idea slowly [[2]], and before long container ships were crossing every major ocean. [[3]] once at the factory, goods could now travel halfway around the world without being touched again.
Shipping became so cheap that companies could make their products wherever labor cost the least. This, [[4]], changed where factories were built and where millions of people found work. Today, nearly everything in our homes has spent part of its journey inside one of these boxes, yet as they roll past us on the highway, few of us [[5]].

tags.key_phrase: There was one catch（只有一個問題、但書）
win out（經過一番較量後終於勝出）
Packed …, goods could …（過去分詞構句：goods 是被裝箱的）
give … a second thought（多想一下、多看一眼）

tags.topic: 貨櫃如何改變世界貿易

1.explanation_zh: catch 當名詞時有「（表面上看不出來的）問題、麻煩、但書」的意思，There was one catch 就是「只有一個問題」。冒號後面正是這個問題：全世界的港口、船隻和鐵路必須使用同一種尺寸的箱子，整套系統才行得通。
evidence: There was one [[1]]: the system would only work if ports, ships, and railways around the world all used boxes of the same size.

option_notes_zh.A: 【強誘答・LR】benefit（好處）符合全文「貨櫃帶來好處」的大方向，但冒號後說的是「只有在……的條件下才行得通」，是限制和難處，不是好處，方向相反。
option_notes_zh.C: habit（習慣）：冒號後說的是系統要成功的條件，不是任何人的習慣，語意不通。
option_notes_zh.D: custom（習俗、慣例）容易讓人聯想到港口的 customs（海關），但「有一項習俗：系統只有在……才行得通」語意不通。

1.strategy_zh: 冒號後面的內容就是空格名詞的說明。注意 would only work if（只有在……才行得通）表示限制條件，要找表示「難處、但書」的名詞，而不是「好處」。線索在本句。
hints: 冒號後面在說明空格的名詞是什麼。
the system would only work if … 是一項好處，還是一個必須克服的條件？
catch 當名詞可以表示「隱藏的問題、但書」。

2.explanation_zh: win out 是「（經過一番爭鬥或競爭後）終於勝出、佔上風」。碼頭工人擔心丟掉工作，起初反對這項改變（fought the change），but 表示轉折：這個點子最後慢慢勝出；句尾也說，不久之後貨櫃船就航行於各大洋之間。
evidence: Dock workers, fearing for their jobs, fought the change at first, but the idea slowly [[2]], and before long container ships were crossing every major ocean.

option_notes_zh.A: 【強誘答・CN】wore out 和正解字形相近，同樣是「動詞＋out」，但 wear out 是「（東西）用壞、磨破」，點子不會被「用壞」；而且與句尾「不久貨櫃船就橫越各大洋」的成功結果相反。
option_notes_zh.B: went out 是「（燈火）熄滅、（流行）退燒」，表示點子沒落，與 but 的轉折及句尾的成功結果矛盾。
option_notes_zh.C: passed out 是「昏倒、失去知覺」，主詞是點子，語意不通。

2.strategy_zh: 先看 fought the change at first（起初反對）和 but 的轉折：起初被反對 → 後來勝出；再用句尾 before long container ships were crossing every major ocean 確認結果是成功。四個選項都是「動詞＋out」，要分辨動詞。線索在本句。
hints: fought the change at first … but … 表示前後的情況相反。
句尾說不久之後貨櫃船怎麼了？這個點子最後成功還是失敗？
要選表示「經過一番較量後勝出」的片語。

3.explanation_zh: 主要子句的主詞是 goods（貨物），貨物是「被」裝進箱子的，所以用過去分詞 Packed 開頭的分詞構句，相當於 After they were packed once at the factory。貨物只要在工廠裝箱一次，就能運到半個地球之外，途中不必再被碰觸。
evidence: [[3]] once at the factory, goods could now travel halfway around the world without being touched again.

option_notes_zh.B: 【強誘答・GN】Packing 是主動的現在分詞，表示 goods 自己去打包，主詞和動作的關係錯了；學生常因為「句首分詞多半用 V-ing」而誤選。
option_notes_zh.C: To pack 放在句首表示目的（為了打包），「為了在工廠打包一次，貨物可以運到……」語意不通。
option_notes_zh.D: Having packed 是主動的完成式分詞，表示 goods 先完成了打包的動作，主動被動同樣錯誤；被動要寫成 Having been packed。

3.strategy_zh: 分詞構句的邏輯主詞就是主要子句的主詞。先找出主詞 goods，再問：貨物是自己打包，還是被打包？被動用過去分詞。線索在本句。
hints: 逗號後面主要子句的主詞是什麼？
goods 和 pack 是主動還是被動的關係？
被動的分詞構句用過去分詞。

4.explanation_zh: in turn 是「進而、連帶地」，表示一連串的因果：運費變便宜 → 公司可以到勞力最便宜的地方生產 → 這進而改變了工廠設在哪裡、數百萬人在哪裡找到工作。
evidence: Shipping became so cheap that companies could make their products wherever labor cost the least.
This, [[4]], changed where factories were built and where millions of people found work.

option_notes_zh.A: 【強誘答・CN】in return 和 in turn 字面很像，但意思是「作為回報、交換」，前後兩句並沒有互相回報的關係。
option_notes_zh.B: in vain 是「徒勞無功」，但 This 確實改變了工廠的位置和工作機會，並沒有白費。
option_notes_zh.D: in private 是「私下、不公開地」，工廠位置和數百萬人的工作機會的改變是公開、全面的結果，與「私下」無關。

4.strategy_zh: This 指前一句的內容。把兩句的關係寫成箭頭：便宜的運輸 → 到處設廠 → 改變就業地圖，是「一環扣一環」的連鎖結果。線索在前一句。
hints: This 指的是前一句的哪件事？
前一句和本句之間是回報、徒勞，還是一連串的因果？
要選表示「進而、連帶地」的片語。

5.explanation_zh: give … a second thought 是「多想一下、留意」，few of us give them a second thought 就是「我們很少有人會多看它們一眼」。這呼應第一句：對大多數人來說，貨櫃只是卡車後面的大鐵箱；yet 則點出對比——我們家裡幾乎每樣東西都坐過貨櫃，卻很少人注意到它們。
evidence: To most people, the shipping container is just a large metal box on the back of a truck
Today, nearly everything in our homes has spent part of its journey inside one of these boxes, yet as they roll past us on the highway, few of us [[5]].

option_notes_zh.A: 【強誘答・LR】take them for granted（視為理所當然）看似呼應「貨櫃被忽略」的主題，但前面有 few of us，「很少人把它們視為理所當然」反而變成大多數人都很重視它們，與第一句和 yet 的對比相反。
option_notes_zh.C: put them to good use 是「善加利用」，一般人並不會直接使用貨櫃，也和 yet 要表達的對比無關。
option_notes_zh.D: lend them a hand 是「幫它們一把」，對象是公路上駛過的貨櫃，語意不通。

5.strategy_zh: 這格要回到第一句：對大多數人來說，貨櫃「只是一個大鐵箱」。再看 yet：東西都靠它運送，我們卻……？注意 few of us 本身已經帶有否定，要把 few 和選項合起來判斷方向。線索在第一句（距離超過兩句）與本句。
hints: 第一句說大多數人怎麼看待貨櫃？
yet 表示前後對比：貨櫃這麼重要，我們卻怎樣？
few of us＋選項＝「很少人……」，要選合起來表示「很少人注意到它們」的片語。

translation_zh.text:
對大多數人來說，貨櫃只不過是卡車後面的一個大鐵箱，但很少有發明比它更深刻地塑造了現代世界。1950 年代以前，碼頭工人靠人力裝船，把一袋袋、一桶桶、一箱箱的貨物一件一件扛上船，因此一艘船停在港口的時間，可能和它在海上航行的時間差不多長。
美國一位經營卡車運輸的商人麥克連（Malcom McLean）認為一定有更好的辦法。他的答案是一個鋼製箱子，從卡車到船再到火車，一路都不必打開。只有一個問題：全世界的港口、船隻和鐵路都必須使用同一種尺寸的箱子，這套系統才行得通。碼頭工人擔心丟掉工作，起初反對這項改變，但這個點子最後慢慢勝出，不久之後，貨櫃船就航行於各大洋之間。貨物只要在工廠裝箱一次，就能運到半個地球之外，途中不必再被碰觸。
運輸變得非常便宜，公司可以到勞力成本最低的地方生產產品。這進而改變了工廠設在哪裡，以及數百萬人在哪裡找到工作。今天，我們家裡幾乎每一樣東西，在運送途中都曾在這種箱子裡待過一段時間；然而當它們在公路上從我們身邊駛過時，我們很少有人會多看它們一眼。

evidence: There was one [[1]]: the system would only work if ports, ships, and railways around the world all used boxes of the same size.
1.explanation_zh: 冒號後說明這個系統成立的前提條件（全世界都得用同一尺寸的箱子），是一個「隱藏的難處、但書」，catch 指隱藏的問題或條件；benefit 好處與後文限制條件不合，habit、custom 是習慣、風俗，語意不通。

evidence: Dock workers, fearing for their jobs, fought the change at first, but the idea slowly [[2]], and before long container ships were crossing every major ocean.
2.explanation_zh: but 表轉折：碼頭工人起初反對，但這個構想終究「勝出、被接受」，之後貨櫃船遍布各大洋，故選 won out；wore out 磨損、went out 熄滅／過時、passed out 昏倒都與後文相反或無關。

evidence: [[3]] once at the factory, goods could now travel halfway around the world without being touched again.
3.explanation_zh: 分詞構句的主詞是 goods，貨物是「被包裝」的，應用過去分詞 Packed（= Once they were packed at the factory）；Packing、Having packed 表主動，To pack 表目的，皆不合。

evidence: Shipping became so cheap that companies could make their products wherever labor cost the least.
This, [[4]], changed where factories were built and where millions of people found work.
4.explanation_zh: 運費便宜讓公司把工廠設在勞力最便宜處，這件事「進而、接著」改變了工廠地點與就業分布，是連鎖因果，in turn 最合適；in return 作為回報、in vain 徒勞、in private 私下，皆不合。

evidence: Today, nearly everything in our homes has spent part of its journey inside one of these boxes, yet as they roll past us on the highway, few of us [[5]].
5.explanation_zh: yet 表對比：貨櫃影響我們生活的一切，但它們從公路上經過時，很少人會「多想一下」，few of us give them a second thought 才符合文意；take them for granted 前接 few 會變成「很少人視為理所當然」，與文意相反；put them to good use、lend them a hand 不合語境。

evidence: There was one [[1]]: the system would only work if ports, ships, and railways around the world all used boxes of the same size.
1.explanation_zh: 後面冒號說明系統只有在各地貨櫃尺寸一致時才行得通，這是一個「問題／但書」，catch 指隱藏的缺點。

evidence: Dock workers, fearing for their jobs, fought the change at first, but the idea slowly [[2]], and before long container ships were crossing every major ocean.
2.explanation_zh: 碼頭工人起初反對，但這個想法慢慢「勝出」，之後貨櫃船就航行各大洋；won out 表示最後占上風。

evidence: [[3]] once at the factory, goods could now travel halfway around the world without being touched again.
3.explanation_zh: 省略主詞的分詞構句：goods 是「被包裝」的，所以用過去分詞 Packed once at the factory（= Once they were packed）。

evidence: This, [[4]], changed where factories were built and where millions of people found work.
4.explanation_zh: 運費變便宜導致公司把工廠設在勞力最便宜處，接著又改變了工廠位置與就業，是一連串因果的下一步，in turn（接著、轉而）最貼切。

evidence: Today, nearly everything in our homes has spent part of its journey inside one of these boxes, yet as they roll past us on the highway, few of us [[5]].
5.explanation_zh: yet 表示轉折：家裡幾乎所有東西都靠貨櫃運來，但貨櫃經過時很少人會多想一下（give them a second thought）。

A.evidence: There was one [[1]]: the system would only work if ports, ships, and railways around the world all used boxes of the same size.
A.explanation_zh: 冒號後說明的是「只有在全世界都用同一尺寸的箱子時才行得通」這個限制條件，是要克服的難處，不是好處；There was one benefit 和冒號後的內容方向相反。

C.evidence: There was one [[1]]: the system would only work if ports, ships, and railways around the world all used boxes of the same size.
C.explanation_zh: 冒號後是系統成立的條件，不是任何人的習慣，habit 無法被冒號後的內容說明。

D.evidence: There was one [[1]]: the system would only work if ports, ships, and railways around the world all used boxes of the same size.
D.explanation_zh: custom（習俗、慣例）無法說明「全世界的港口、船隻與鐵路都必須用同一尺寸」這個系統條件；容易和 customs（海關）聯想，但語意不通。

A.evidence: Dock workers, fearing for their jobs, fought the change at first, but the idea slowly [[2]], and before long container ships were crossing every major ocean.
A.explanation_zh: wear out 是「用壞、磨損」；but 之後接的是 before long container ships were crossing every major ocean 的成功結果，「點子慢慢被用壞」與此相反。

B.evidence: Dock workers, fearing for their jobs, fought the change at first, but the idea slowly [[2]], and before long container ships were crossing every major ocean.
B.explanation_zh: go out 是「熄滅、退流行」，表示點子沒落，與 but 的轉折及句尾貨櫃船遍布各大洋的結果矛盾。

C.evidence: Dock workers, fearing for their jobs, fought the change at first, but the idea slowly [[2]], and before long container ships were crossing every major ocean.
C.explanation_zh: pass out 是「昏倒」，主詞是 the idea，點子不會昏倒。

B.evidence: [[3]] once at the factory, goods could now travel halfway around the world without being touched again.
B.explanation_zh: 分詞構句的邏輯主詞是 goods，貨物是「被」裝箱的；Packing 表主動，等於說貨物自己去打包。

C.evidence: [[3]] once at the factory, goods could now travel halfway around the world without being touched again.
C.explanation_zh: 句首 To pack 表目的，邏輯主詞同樣是 goods：「貨物為了在工廠打包一次而能運到半個地球外」不通，主被動關係也錯。

D.evidence: [[3]] once at the factory, goods could now travel halfway around the world without being touched again.
D.explanation_zh: Having packed 是主動的完成式分詞，表示貨物先完成了打包的動作；被動要寫成 Having been packed。

A.evidence: Shipping became so cheap that companies could make their products wherever labor cost the least.
A.explanation_zh: 前一句是「運費便宜 → 到勞力最便宜處生產」，本句接著說這進而改變工廠位置與就業，是連鎖因果；in return（作為回報）沒有可以對應的交換關係。

B.evidence: This, [[4]], changed where factories were built and where millions of people found work.
B.explanation_zh: in vain 是「徒勞」，但本句明說 This 確實 changed where factories were built，結果發生了，不是白費。

D.evidence: This, [[4]], changed where factories were built and where millions of people found work.
D.explanation_zh: in private 是「私下」，改變數百萬人在哪裡工作是全面、公開的結果，與「私下」無關。

A.evidence: To most people, the shipping container is just a large metal box on the back of a truck
A.explanation_zh: few of us take them for granted＝「很少人把它們視為理所當然」，等於說大多數人很重視貨櫃，和第一句「對大多數人來說只是一個大鐵箱」以及本句 yet 的對比相反。

C.evidence: Today, nearly everything in our homes has spent part of its journey inside one of these boxes, yet as they roll past us on the highway, few of us [[5]].
C.explanation_zh: put them to good use（善加利用）：一般人不會使用公路上駛過的貨櫃，也無法和 yet 前面「東西都靠它運送」形成「重要卻被忽略」的對比。

D.evidence: Today, nearly everything in our homes has spent part of its journey inside one of these boxes, yet as they roll past us on the highway, few of us [[5]].
D.explanation_zh: lend them a hand（幫它們一把）的對象是公路上駛過的貨櫃，語意不通。
